label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Depth ordering is retained, but the simplified equipment against largely empty walls and floor reads as a sparse set rather than a complete occupied shop.

The pale bench has a dotted top, blue vise and leg-hung clamps, but lacks readable folding construction and visibly integrated yellow spacer blocks. Its perforated end panels are upright rather than splayed.
The elongated rear bench has dense circular log-end motifs with varied diameters, tan tones and dark bark-like borders.
Drill press, lamp and CNC are recognizable and broadly ordered correctly, but the saw is an undifferentiated stack of boxes beside a rail without a recognizable plunge-saw silhouette.
A stocked multi-tier lumber rack is present. Background rods lack recognizable clamp jaws and hanging organization; the red blocks do not read clearly as bins or tubs.
A dark stove body with a front door panel and connected rising flue is recognizable behind the rear bench.
Pale panel construction, tan matte tops and contrasting edge strips sustain a simplified plywood/MDF appearance across the benches and shelving.
The visible gray floor is a uniform studio-like plane without discernible concrete mottling, seams or wear; sampling noise does not establish surface variation.

The lamp has native base, angled arms and shade meshes. A warm 55-energy area light lies at its shade, while warm overhead area lights provide top-down illumination. The authored view shows a bright lamp head and locally lit bench.
The elevated front three-quarter view provides bottom-edge callout space and shows the hero well, but crops most of the lumber rack and part of the saw, compromising the complete equipment overview.
The original final.png is a successfully decoded PNG. The blend opens and retains 445 meshes, assigned materials, three native lights and an active camera matching the delivered composition.

dimension_scores.evidence: The main bench arrangement and log fascia are recognizable, but shop density, machine detail and folding-bench construction are substantially simplified.
Benches have visible supports, but the stove and adjacent stock shelf visibly float above the floor without supporting construction.
Pale framing, tan tops, blue equipment and dark stove preserve the main palette; box-like silhouettes lose characteristic tool shapes.
Primitive machine forms, repetitive log discs, unsupported fixtures and strong noise in the original delivery weaken credibility.
Parallel foreground and rear benches, the aisle, left lumber storage and right stove preserve the principal spatial relationships.
Equipment sizes are broadly coherent, but the hero is unusually long and squat and the surrounding room is oversized and sparsely occupied.
Warm soft illumination and contact shadows are readable. Surfaces have little material variation, and the original render is conspicuously noisy.
Both benches, rack, drill press, router, lamp and stove are present. Recognizable saw details, background clamps, bins and visible yellow bench fittings are lacking.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
